title: A Unified Arena for LLM Agents across Diverse Eurogame
abstract: arXiv:2610.35773v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Interactive environments offer a practical way to evaluate large language model (LLM) agents, and competitive games extend this evaluation to decisions shaped by competing goals and other agents' choices. Yet existing evaluations confined to individual games or execution frameworks leave unclear which competitive advantages persist across settings. We introduce DECE (Diverse Eurogame Competitive Environments), a unified arena spanning ten Eurogames with shared interfaces and evaluation protocols. These games combine lasting strategic commitments, competition over shared resources, and multiple routes to victory. Our primary study evaluates 12 model-harness configurations, spanning nine models and four execution harnesses, in 480 three-player matches across ten games. The main and supplementary studies comprise 1,032 completed matches in total. These comparisons reveal broad cross-game ranking agreement alongside game-specific strengths.

translated_title: 面向大语言模型智能体的跨多样欧式桌游统一竞技场
translated_abstract: 交互式环境为评估大语言模型（LLM）智能体提供了一种实用的方式，而竞技类游戏则将这种评估扩展到受竞争目标和其他智能体决策所影响的决策场景中。然而，现有评估局限于单个游戏或特定执行框架，导致难以明确哪些竞争优势能够跨设置持续存在。我们提出了DECE（多样欧式桌游竞技环境，Diverse Eurogame Competitive Environments），这是一个覆盖十款欧式桌游的统一竞技场，具有共享的接口和评估协议。这些游戏兼具持久的战略承诺、对共享资源的竞争以及多种获胜途径。我们的主要研究评估了12种模型-执行框架配置，涵盖九个模型和四种执行框架，在十款游戏中进行了480场三人比赛。主研究和补充研究共计完成了1,032场比赛。这些比较揭示了广泛的跨游戏排名一致性，同时也发现了各游戏特有的优势。
tldr: 提出了DECE——一个覆盖十款欧式桌游、具有统一接口和评估协议的竞技环境，通过1,032场比赛系统评估LLM智能体的竞争性决策能力，揭示了广泛的跨游戏排名一致性与游戏特定优势。
en_tdlr: We introduce DECE, a unified arena spanning ten Eurogames with shared interfaces and evaluation protocols, which systematically evaluates LLM agents' competitive decision-making through 1,032 matches and reveals broad cross-game ranking agreement alongside game-specific strengths.
